summary: Iteration 15 tested the 3 requested features. BACKEND: 16/16 pytest cases pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter15_pricing_stripe_pptx.py) — 3-login regression with correct roles, /api/owner/business/pricing (3 school + 6 MAT tiers, exact GBP values, 403 non-owner, 401 unauth), NEW /api/owner/stripe/status (connected=true, mode=test, key_tail, webhook_configured=false bool, instructions; 403 non-owner), /api/plans + /api/billing/checkout (returns real Stripe url + session_id), and /api/teacher/lessons/{id}/pptx (200 + correct MIME + attachment + PK zip magic + >5KB; owner allowed; 404 missing; 403 cross-school teacher; 401 unauth). FRONTEND: the teacher 'Make PowerPoint' flow works end-to-end (real 39,923-byte .pptx downloaded via UI). CRITICAL: the claimed Owner UI changes DO NOT EXIST — /app/frontend/src/pages/Owner.jsx contains no BusinessPanel, no MAT/school pricing tables and no Stripe status card (grep for BusinessPanel/business-panel/stripe-status/mat-tier/school-tier across all of /app/frontend/src returns ZERO hits), and the live /owner Overview tab renders 0 of the required testids and no 'Stripe' text. So 2 of the 3 requested features are backend-only and invisible to the user.

minor.issue: Price inconsistency: BUSINESS_PRICING school tiers are £3,000/£8,000/£15,000 but the actual chargeable Stripe PLANS are school_small £750, school_medium £1,500, school_large £3,000. Owner-facing pricing and the real checkout amounts disagree — confirm which is intended before surfacing in the UI.

webhook_configured is false because STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set in /app/backend/.env (expected; endpoint returns the correct bool). Also connected=true for the placeholder key 'sk_test_emergent', so 'connected' means 'a key string is present', not 'key is valid with Stripe' — consider a lightweight Stripe ping or renaming to key_present.
Field is plan_id (not plan) and origin_url is mandatory — the review request/docs say 'plan'. Carried over from iteration 14.
